name: gizza-ai/file-to-data-uri
summary: Encode a file as a base64 data: URI.

tool.description: Encode a (small) file as a self-contained base64 data: URI — 'data:;base64,<...>' — for inline embedding in CSS url(...), an , an email, or a JSON payload. The content type is taken from the file unless you pass a mime override. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Best for assets up to a few MB.

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

mime.description: Optional MIME type to embed (e.g. image/png). Defaults to the file's detected content type.
